Short title and commencement

SINDH (AMENDMENT OF LAW), ACT, 1997
SINDH (AMENDMENT OF LAW), ACT, 1997
An Act to provide relief in
certain taxes and amend certain laws
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 27th September, 1997]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑18/97,
dated 27‑9‑1997.‑‑The Sindh (Amendment of Laws) Bill,
1997 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June, 1997
and assented to by the Government of Sindh on 3rd September, 1997 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Sindh (Amendment
of Laws) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from the 1st day of July, 1997.

Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act XV of 1973

No.PAS/Legis‑B‑18/97,
dated 27‑9‑1997.‑‑The Sindh (Amendment of Laws) Bill,
1997 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June, 1997
and assented to by the Government of Sindh on 3rd September, 1997 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sindh Act XV of 1973.‑‑In the Stamp Act, 1899, in its
application to the Province of Sindh in Schedule I, in Article 13, in clause
(a), for the abbreviation and figure "Rs.3", the abbreviation and
figure "Rs.2", shall be substituted.

In the Sindh Finance Act, 1996, section 7 shall be deleted
